`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
A design system has two layers that can mature independently. Here the **token** layer (brand colours, Phosphor, Sheet/Dialog) is already the default; the **component** layer (Button, Card, EmptyState) is still optional. That is why Card can exist, be published, and have one consumer — and why 364 copies of `text-[10px]` are not sloppiness, they are a missing scale step the UI already agreed on.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

## Maturity verdict: 3 (defined)

The library, tokens, and Phosphor rule exist and are the intended path. Settings, workspaces, and library dialogs consume them. Components are still optional: Card has one consumer, 98 files ship raw `<button>`, empty states and confirms fork per module. Defined, not managed.

Evidence: grep/glob counts on the 2026-09-17 worktree (317 non-test TSX files); screens were not rendered. Report: `/Users/danielpiatkowski/AI-Agent-Workspace/omnipus/wt-release-session/docs/internal/ui-audit-2026-09-17/lane-d-consistency.md`

## Top 3 fixes
1. Put 10px / 11px on the type scale and ban new `text-[Npx]` (575 of 666 arbitrary type classes).
2. Make `Button` (compact ghost-icon size) the only chrome button, and one AlertDialog-based confirm the only confirm — including replacing `window.confirm` in the library unsaved guard.
3. Give EmptyState title / description / action slots, delete the local copies, and name three Sheet sizes so create / detail / wizard stop inventing pixel widths.
